questions.q: What kinds of returns do you prepare?
questions.a: Corporate, partnership, individual, trust and estate returns, federal and state. Our client base is broadly diversified and includes individuals, sole proprietorships, trusts, partnerships and corporations involved in numerous industries.

questions.q: Can you represent me before the IRS?
questions.a: Yes. We provide representation before regulatory bodies, including the IRS and state or local taxing authorities. Doug Thomson has represented numerous individuals and businesses in tax controversies; in one situation he assisted a client that resulted in a tax assessment being lowered by over $1,000,000.

questions.q: How do I get my documents to you?
questions.a: Through our client portal. Starting with the 2025 tax season we use TaxDome. If you do not have an account, call the office and we will create one for you and send you an invitation so you can set up your password.

questions.q: Do you only work with us at tax time?
questions.a: No. We are dedicated to serving client needs throughout the year, not just at tax time, and we strive to respond quickly to any concerns our clients have.

services.title: QuickBooks
services.summary: Setup, training, data entry and cleanup.
services.text: We offer QuickBooks training, data entry and data cleanup. Invite us in as your accountant so we can easily discuss your books and make real-time changes with your permission.
services.lead: Although QuickBooks is designed for the layman to understand, the initial setup of chart of accounts, determination of your QuickBooks starting date, and installation must be done correctly for future information and reports to be accurate.

covers.title: QuickSetup
covers.text: The initial setup of the chart of accounts, determination of your QuickBooks starting date and installation, done correctly so that future information and reports are accurate.

covers.title: Accountant access
covers.text: If you already use QuickBooks, you can invite us in as your accountant so we can access your QuickBooks Online company files, and discuss or make changes in real-time, with your approval.

covers.title: Personal QuickBooks training
covers.text: One-on-one consulting is available, with on-site and off-site training offered for your convenience.

covers.title: Data entry
covers.text: Entry of list information such as customers, vendors and items, opening balances, and other historical transactions including checks, deposits and customer invoices.

covers.title: Data cleanup
covers.text: Reconciling bank and credit card accounts and correcting the accounting of individual transactions, to produce tax return ready financial statements.

covers.title: Report customization
covers.text: Creating, customizing and memorizing the reports you want to see.

about.title: A full-service tax and accounting firm in Northwest Houston.
text: ATR Tax Advisors is a full-service tax and accounting firm. All our CPAs hold valid TX State CPA Certificates, and our firm is a vetted member of the RamseyTrusted Tax Pros referral program.

Dealing with the IRS and paying taxes makes many people feel anxious. Small business owners want to focus on serving their clients, but many are uncertain when it comes to the intricacies of the tax law or how to structure their business to reduce their tax liability. Our services are valuable to our clients because of the personal attention we incorporate into every engagement to help address issues they are facing.

Our client base is broadly diversified and includes individuals, sole proprietorships, trusts, partnerships and corporations involved in numerous industries. New engagements are accepted only when our firm has the knowledge, experience, and adequate staffing to meet a new client's needs.

The firm is sensitive to the common goal of controlling costs and works closely with each client to minimize fees in a matter that is consistent with maintaining quality service. Because we do not have the overhead burden of a large firm, we are able to offer high-quality services at local firm, cost-effective rates.

values.title: Responsiveness

values.title: Quality
values.text: As trusted advisors, we are available to assist our clients at any time to provide insightful advice that enables them to make informed financial decisions.

values.title: Confidentiality
values.text: The services provided by our firm comply with the high standards of the accounting profession's code of ethics, and all matters handled are treated with strict confidentiality.

values.title: Communication
values.text: Open communication is a vital factor in any good client and professional relationship. Our goal is to communicate with you in a manner that leaves you well informed and comfortable.

team.name: Douglas B. Thomson
team.bio: Doug's primary interest is to help businesses and individuals lower their taxes and increase their profits. He prepares clients' corporate, partnership, individual, trust and estate tax returns, and has represented numerous individuals and businesses in tax controversies. Starting a new business? Doug can help you make the appropriate choice of entity and of picking an accounting system. His audit experience enables him to reconcile any business's books and records, with exposure to many different accounting systems including Great Plains, Xero and QuickBooks.

team.name: Tim Roddy
team.bio: Tim Roddy is a Certified Public Accountant with an MBA and a managerial background in the food industry. Having first-hand experience with budgeting, inventory management and customer service, he understands the specific challenges and opportunities businesses face. After becoming a CPA he worked at an accounting firm and was promoted to a senior position, where he gained extensive experience in tax planning and compliance and financial statement preparation. As a vetted RamseyTrusted tax pro, Tim is known for his ability to provide clear, actionable advice to clients.

team.name: Cristian Garcia
team.bio: Cristian graduated with honors from Stephen F. Austin State University with a bachelor's degree in Accounting and a Master of Professional Accountancy. He is CPA eligible, and joined our firm in 2022 as a tax associate. Hablamos Español.

team.name: Blake Enstrom
team.bio: Blake earned a bachelor's degree in Accounting and a Master of Science in Accounting from Texas Tech University. He is currently pursuing his CPA certification and joined our firm in 2025. Blake assists businesses and individuals with filing their tax returns, devising strategies to minimize tax liabilities and ensuring compliance with tax laws.
